query:
INSERT INTO access.placement (tenant_id, subject_kind, subject, version, cell, dedicated, since)
         SELECT $1, $2, $3,
                COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM access.placement
                           WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND subject_kind = $2 AND subject = $3), 0) + 1,
                $4, $5, $6
         RETURNING version
